articles.title: Encoder Disaggregation in vLLM: Scaling Multimodal Serving with EPD
articles.summary: Multimodal inference adds an encoding stage before language-model execution. Images, video frames, and audio must be processed into embeddings before the language model can use them. The demand on this stage varies with media size, modality, and request mix, and can change independently of prefill and decode demand. Encoder / Prefill / Decode (EPD) disaggregation separates these stages into independently deployed vLLM instances. articles.summary: Multi-vector embedding models give each query token its own opportunity to find a match in a document.
